summary: For day-39 hypothalamus, 28 of the 29 gene effects printed in Figure 7 matched registered results. All 28 agreed in direction (Pearson 0.9954, Spearman 0.9854). CLDN9 lacked a registered DE coefficient. The proposal records a selected-gene comparison below the 30-pair concordance minimum. [Original manuscript](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41598-026-71457-7_reference.pdf)
openIssues: The publisher inventory omits the cited Table S9 workbook. The full tested-gene table and per-gene author P values and FDR remain unavailable, so inference agreement is unassessed.
The manuscript leaves the fitted role of RNA integrity number unclear. Its significance thresholds and the tissue headers in the day-39 correlation workbook also need author clarification.
